title: The quiet guardian
personality: Calm, patient and protective; speaks rarely, notices everything, and puts the party first without being asked.
voice: Few words, plain and kind; a rare joke lands harder for being rare.
quirk: Always the last to sit down and the first to stand up when someone approaches.
goal: To keep this party together long enough that nobody has to travel alone again.
hooks: Once guarded a caravan that did not make it, and visits the road where it happened.
Carries a token from someone they promised to protect.
Hums an old lullaby when they think no one is listening.
backstory:
{name} learned early that someone has to stand in front, and decided it might as well be them. Work as a guard for hire took {name} along most of the roads between the nations.

After one job went badly wrong, {name} stopped working for coin alone and started looking for people worth protecting. This party, for all its noise, seems worth it.
